prerequisite: BE-1 applied on teammate Mac, legacy queue drained and both health RPCs ready
existing_continuation: GraphRuntimeRepository.recover calls schedule_case_graph_continuations(p_limit=25) on startup and worker recovery intervals. DB decides eligibility and creates one guarded graph job. Do not mint a new case or repeat public START for a Running case.
execution: Continuation re-enters public START and may revalidate/extract initial mail before role 2; not a new agent entry point. Quote persistence must deduplicate unchanged evidence. No roles 3-5 or sending enabled.
success: Unique target; nonempty CandidateSnapshot matches current input_revision and current batch. Separate authenticated GET /api/v1/work-cases/{case_id}/candidates must return200 with same set/revision; inspector does not claim HTTP proof.
fallback: If no candidate set after worker recovery, inspect durable graph job/agent failure and registered supplier_items evidence.

Archived/accepted or stopped non-Running cases must not be silently restarted. Resolve state/reopen policy with DB owner using an agreed transaction; graph resume is currently intentionally unavailable.
If a legacy job/draft/active sender blocks DB continuation, resolve it through its existing guarded completion/reconciliation path before scheduling. Do not delete jobs or bypass health.

verification.review_notes: Independent health probes; BE-2 storage-only scope and false acceptance/HTTP flags; intervention states distinguish resume/input/send resolution.

runtime_policy_override.source: 2026-11-04 PR41 review correction; supersedes previous runtime override
runtime_policy_override.policy: No temporary AGENT switches and no duplicate backend role lists. Graph START worker is optional: unavailable config/interfaces/DB/startup leaves API and mail receiver running. START follows the public graph through role2; no extraction-only fallback.
runtime_policy_override.claim: Only claim_case_graph_run(p_start_from=START). Unified START/REPLY/PLAN claim and review scheduling deferred until DB owner agreement; not called by this runtime.
runtime_policy_override.steps: Steps follow the deployed DB work_cases_check5 (2026-11-05) and agent schemas.ProcessingStep. Running graph steps: EXTRACTING (INFO_EXTRACTOR), SELECTING_CANDIDATES (CANDIDATE running), GENERATING_PLANS (INFO_PRIORITY/RESPONSE_PLAN/COUNTER_OFFER). CANDIDATES is the post-graph user-selection wait set by complete_case_graph_run. Terminal: REVIEW_READY/ON_HOLD/FAILED. BUILDING_PLANS and BUILDING_COUNTER_OFFER are not written (DB rejects them).
runtime_policy_override.deployment: After DB functions are deployed restart server to attach graph worker; missing graph does not prevent mail/API startup. API START still requires readiness/live worker. /ready reports mail readiness and degraded review separately.
